title: C'mon Tigre's debut album
description: C'mon Tigre, the Italian band active since 2013, and their 2014 debut album: a mix of rock, jazz and soul with Gonjasufi's wildness and Beirut's melodies.
author: Nir Hasson
intro: The first issue. I'll keep sharing things I loved and found around the web, and there will probably be more talk about music. Let's begin with a band I can't stop recommending.

text: C'mon Tigre are an Italian band that has been active since 2013 and has released five albums so far. On their debut album, released in 2014, you'll hear a mix of rock, jazz and soul, a lovely and interesting blend. Think a little of Gonjasufi's wildness alongside Beirut's melodies. I loved it and recommend it to you too.

Recommended songs: "Federation Tunisienne De Football" and "Building Society - The Great Collapse". After this they released several more interesting albums worth exploring, with more hip-hop, Brazilian and African influences and more collaborations, for example with Seun Kuti and Mick Jenkins.
